cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've calculated the optimal move in this raffle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You buy a ticket. That's all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Timing is crucial. Tell me when to buy; I'll have the money ready.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you pick my ticket. I'll let the shuffle distribute my advantage.

reason: A gives B purchase timing and ticket choice in response to the rules while maintaining invented probability expertise.
